newsitem.title: USA: Dow ends above 5900 for first time as bonds rally.
newsitem.headline: Dow ends above 5900 for first time as bonds rally.

text.p: The Dow industrials ended above 5900 for the first time in history, and other stock indices shattered records on the first trading day of the fourth quarter, bolstered by a rally in the bond market.

"The market just keeps on trucking along. The pressure of (mutual fund) money is still there and as the day wore on, the strength in bonds transmitted to the equity market," said Marshall Acuff, portfolio strategist at Smith Barney.
The Dow industrials rose 23 to about 5905, topping the previous record closing high of 5894.74 set on September 23.

Among special situations, Xilinx, which supplies programmable logic devices to the phone and data networking industries, shed 2-3/8 to 31-5/8 after forecasting net income and revenue for the second quarter ended September 28 would be below the first quarter's. UBS Securities cut the stock to hold from buy while other brokers slashed earnings estimates.
Micron lost 1-3/8 to 29-1/8 amid chip sector weakness and news that Micron shuffled its board of directors.
